Pustadobos Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Kossuth utca 10, Hungary

Not demolished. This record appears to be a duplicate of another entry in this collection, 'Pusztadobos Jewish Cemetery' (correctly spelled), sharing the same coordinates, address, and physical site description. Unlike that entry, however, this record's description field contains only placeholder text ('Let's say we have some text here') rather than genuine historical content — flagged here rather than treated as real information. The genuine portion of the site notes confirms the cemetery is in good condition, with part of the area marked on the cadastral map now used as an orchard.
